headline: Modern Warfare 2: Sequel to CoD 4
title: Modern Warfare 2 Facts | Infinity Ward 2009 | Classic Games
video_script: Call of Duty, Modern Warfare two was released worldwide on November tenth, two thousand nine, for Windows, PlayStation three and Xbox 360. Infinity Ward developed it and Activision published it. It is the sixth game in the Call of Duty series and the direct sequel to Call of Duty four, Modern Warfare. Better than Call of Duty four?
